pairs.question: Cuius loci es tu vel quid acturus huc venisti? Responde.
pairs.answer: Comes Valentiniani sum, orbis terrarum domini, ad opprimendum latronem funereum missus.
pairs.derivation: King Igmazen asks Theodosius two genuine interrogatives (cuius loci es tu / quid acturus huc venisti) plus the imperative 'responde'; the mid-utterance speech tag 'inquit' is dropped and first-word capitalization normalized. Theodosius replies; the tag 'ait' is dropped. The answer is cut at the first sentence ending at the colon after 'missus' (the operative reply to who/why); what follows the cut ('quem nisi statim reddideris, ut invictus statuit imperator, peribis funditus cum gente, quam regis') is a threat/elaboration, not part of identifying himself and his purpose, so it is omitted.
